purpose: Professional visual templates for broad comparison before HTML, Remotion, cover, and video implementation.
selectionRule: Compare broadly first. Apply source fidelity, readability, motion-sync, and Remotion feasibility before implementation.

avoidWhen: topic needs warmth, playfulness, or consumer friendliness
templates.typography: large Chinese serif or strong display headline; clean sans body; mono metadata
templates.layoutGrammar: two-zone composition: claim/focus on one side, proof artifact on the other; stable top progress rail
templates.artifactTreatment: source diagrams, architecture maps, node paths, decision gates, evaluation loops
remotionCues: stable artifact bounds
subtitle-safe bottom band
stage labels from scene graph
templates.risk: Can become repetitive if every episode uses it without variation.

templates.typography: editorial serif headline; clean sans body; small mono figure labels
templates.layoutGrammar: paper-like frame, margin notes, figure callouts, ruled sections
templates.artifactTreatment: annotated source diagrams, figure labels, pull quotes, source cards
remotionCues: diagram-first frame
small labels must remain readable
avoid excessive text density
templates.risk: Can feel too static unless focus highlights are carefully timed.

avoidWhen: source has no operational or metric layer
templates.typography: compact sans and mono; strong status labels
templates.layoutGrammar: dashboard bands, trace rows, gate panels, status cards
templates.artifactTreatment: queues, traces, eval gates, metric cards, routing boards
remotionCues: never fake unsupported metrics
align active row to voice phrase
templates.risk: Can imply real telemetry if labels are not clearly conceptual.

avoidWhen: source says concepts are not comparable peers
templates.typography: large decision claim; compact option labels
templates.layoutGrammar: matrix, ladder, gate, triangle, elimination board
templates.artifactTreatment: selection grids, decision gates, tradeoff triangles, compare/eliminate states
remotionCues: do not create false rankings
include caveat when context-dependent
templates.risk: Can flatten taxonomy if axes are not source-faithful.

templates.typography: heavy display headline with geometric body
templates.layoutGrammar: large colored focal card, section number, precise grid
templates.artifactTreatment: single claim card, proof chip, minimal diagram thumbnail
remotionCues: best for cover/opening, not full source diagram scenes
templates.risk: Can overpower source material if used beyond hook/cover moments.

avoidWhen: needs cinematic depth or heavy source artifacts
templates.layoutGrammar: split panels, accent bars, large quote or claim
templates.artifactTreatment: framework block, side diagram, clean quotation proof
remotionCues: works for section openers and simple frameworks
templates.risk: Can feel generic corporate unless source artifact treatment is distinctive.

avoidWhen: serious source fidelity is the main trust signal
templates.layoutGrammar: split field, badges, halftone or texture accents
templates.artifactTreatment: bold labels, contrast callouts, simplified proof chips
remotionCues: use sparingly for opening/transition beats
templates.risk: Can become internet-hype if applied to all scenes.

templates.typography: elegant serif headline with restrained sans body
templates.layoutGrammar: centered editorial layout, thin accent lines, soft abstract forms
templates.artifactTreatment: quote, principle, one elegant diagram outline
remotionCues: best for reflective close or principle scenes
templates.risk: Decorative softness can weaken engineering clarity.

avoidWhen: needs cinematic authority or dark technical style
templates.typography: editorial display with readable sans body
templates.layoutGrammar: paper container with right-side section tabs
templates.artifactTreatment: notes, tabs, taxonomy cards, section dividers
remotionCues: use for structured series previews or chapterized videos
templates.risk: Can look too classroom-like for frontier infrastructure topics.

templates.layoutGrammar: card surface, vertical pills, simple structured blocks
templates.artifactTreatment: simple concept cards, step pills, gentle framework
remotionCues: good for simplifying terms without intimidating viewers

templates.typography: distinctive serif headline with modern sans body
templates.layoutGrammar: asymmetric editorial grid, geometric accent marks, bordered callouts
templates.artifactTreatment: pull quote, myth/fact blocks, one simplified visual metaphor
remotionCues: best for hooks and takeaway frames

avoidWhen: business audience or visual polish matters more than dev authenticity
templates.layoutGrammar: terminal panes, command rows, logs, diff-like highlights
remotionCues: avoid long fake code; keep source claims visible
templates.risk: Can become gimmicky if the source is not developer-operational.

avoidWhen: needs rich cinematic depth or warm emotional narrative
templates.typography: bold geometric sans with clean supporting type
templates.layoutGrammar: visible grid, asymmetric composition, disciplined spacing
templates.artifactTreatment: grid labels, simple shapes, typographic hierarchy
remotionCues: excellent for taxonomy but must protect source labels
templates.risk: Can feel cold or too abstract for source-heavy videos.

avoidWhen: needs operational dashboards or high-energy hook
templates.typography: serif headline and serif/sans body pairing
templates.layoutGrammar: drop cap, pull quote, horizontal rules, measured text columns
templates.artifactTreatment: quote proof, principle card, annotated excerpt
remotionCues: best for source quote moments and reflective closes
templates.risk: May lack enough visual system explanation for complex architecture.

avoidWhen: source fidelity, enterprise trust, or dense diagrams must dominate
templates.typography: rounded modern display and body type
templates.layoutGrammar: two-color vertical split, playful badges, simple icon-label groups
templates.artifactTreatment: simplified concept blocks, friendly contrast cards, small source proof chips
remotionCues: use only when warmth helps comprehension; keep source proof visible
templates.risk: Can feel too casual for serious frontier AI infrastructure.

templates.typography: distinctive futuristic display with clean supporting sans or mono
templates.layoutGrammar: dark field, grid structure, controlled glow, particle or trace accents
templates.artifactTreatment: single proof chip, trace line, high-contrast concept reveal
remotionCues: use sparingly; avoid generic cyberpunk and do not obscure subtitles
templates.risk: Very easy to become generic AI/cyberpunk slop if overused.

bestFor: source has recognizable diagrams, VI, report layout, or product UI
avoidWhen: could imply official endorsement or copy source branding too closely
templates.typography: adapt to source flavor without replacing channel identity
templates.palette: sample from source diagrams or report while keeping project-level identity
templates.layoutGrammar: source artifact as visual anchor with added explanatory layer
templates.artifactTreatment: original diagram, adapted figure, UI screenshot, source table
remotionCues: do not imply endorsement; preserve source labels
templates.risk: Can become too source-branded or visually inconsistent across series.
